editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the SAP Certified Application Associate SAP IBP for Supply Chain exam covering 6 domains with 80 questions and 180 minutes duration.
editorial.overview: The SAP Certified Application Associate — SAP IBP for Supply Chain certification validates expertise across 6 core domains. Candidates are evaluated on their ability to manage supply chain planning concepts, demand planning, inventory optimization, sales and operations planning, supply planning, and SAP IBP configuration and analytics. The exam comprises 80 questions and requires a passing score of 70 percent during the 180 minutes session.
editorial.who_should_take: Supply chain professionals and application consultants with practical experience configuring and managing SAP Integrated Business Planning solutions should pursue this certification to demonstrate their technical knowledge.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Master the core functionalities of SAP Integrated Business Planning by reviewing official SAP study documentation and help portal guides. Focus your study sessions on planning areas, key figure calculations, data integration, and configuration settings to handle the 80 multiple choice, multiple select, drag and drop, and matching questions.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers fundamental supply chain planning concepts and overarching system principles required within the SAP IBP platform to ensure that candidates understand core architectural models and primary planning frameworks effectively.
study_focus: Review core supply chain planning models

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses on demand planning processes, forecasting algorithms, and statistical tools used to predict future product requirements accurately while evaluating historical consumption patterns and leveraging advanced calculation engines.

This domain evaluates inventory optimization techniques, safety stock calculations, and methods for managing stock levels across multi-stage networks to reduce holding costs while maintaining optimal service levels for customers.

This domain addresses sales and operations planning processes, scenario management, and collaborative planning workflows within the application to align executive decision-making with operational execution across global supply chains.

This domain covers supply planning mechanics, heuristic calculations, and supply optimization features designed to balance material and capacity constraints efficiently across complex manufacturing and distribution networks during daily operations.

This domain tests SAP IBP configuration, analytics features, dashboard setup, and administrative tools utilized for system maintenance, reporting, and customization to ensure proper daily performance across the enterprise software environment.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the Pearson VUE test center or log into the online proctored environment early. Manage your 180 minutes carefully across all 80 questions to ensure you complete every section.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of a total of 80 questions delivered in a linear format using multiple choice, multiple select, drag and drop, and matching question types.
Candidates must achieve a passing score of exactly 70 percent in order to successfully pass the examination and earn the professional certification credential issued by SAP.
You are given a total duration of 180 minutes to complete the test during your scheduled online proctored or in-person Pearson VUE testing center examination session.
The price for the exam is set at 562.0 USD. Candidates can register through official SAP learning channels or directly through Pearson VUE for their test.

methodology.summary: This complete editorial overview was generated using verified facts obtained directly from official SAP exam guides, documentation sources, and structured domain definitions.
